title: cyperus meyenianus var. paranaguensis
intro: Cyperus meyenianus var. paranaguensis, commonly known as Paraná sedge, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Paraná sedge include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified through various studies.
